summary: Normalize dense polynomial results after ground multiplication, quotient, exact quotient, and term multiplication, stripping leading zero coefficients at each recursive level. Added EX simplification, integer quotient, and clear_denoms regressions checking canonical zero representation and downstream is_zero, degree, terms_gcd and primitive. Before the fix, the three new regression tests failed (204 passed); after the fix all 262 public tests in test_densearith.py, test_densetools.py, test_polyclasses.py and test_polytools.py passed. git diff --check passed.
